in_marathi.name: Gehna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gehna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gehna is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘geh’ which means ‘gold’. The name Gehna refers to the one who is as radiant and beautiful as gold. In Hindu mythology, Gehna is the name of a goddess of wealth and prosperity.
